extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship comparing two quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rate associated with one unit of a quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional Relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship between two quantities with a constant ratio.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of Proportionality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The constant ratio in a proportional relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that can be expressed as a ratio of integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that is not rational.

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The distance of a number from zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest Common Factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The largest common factor of two whole numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Number Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A line used to represent and order numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Standard Algorithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A written procedure for multi-digit computation.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimal Operations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing decimals.

extracted_concepts.name: Variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A letter that stands for a number.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A symbol showing repeated multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: Properties of Integer Exponents
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules for working with integer exponents.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent Expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expressions that have the same value.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An equation representing a linear relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement comparing expressions using > or <.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rule assigning each input exactly one output.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function defined by y = mx + b.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change of a line.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A theorem relating the legs and hypotenuse of a right triangle.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of two-dimensional space.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of three-dimensional space.

extracted_concepts.name: Surface Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The total area of the surfaces of a solid.

extracted_concepts.name: Circle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A set of points equidistant from a center.

extracted_concepts.name: Congruence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures with the same shape and size.

extracted_concepts.name: Rotation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A turn of a figure about a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Reflection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A flip of a figure across a line.

extracted_concepts.name: Translation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A slide of a figure without turning.

extracted_concepts.name: Dilation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A resizing transformation using a scale factor.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A graph of bivariate data points.

extracted_concepts.name: Two-way Table
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A table summarizing data for two variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A question that anticipates variability.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summaries such as mean and median.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Variability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summaries such as interquartile range and mean absolute deviation.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability Model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A model used to represent a chance process.

extracted_concepts.name: Random Sampling
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Selecting a sample randomly from a population.

extracted_concepts.name: Scale Drawing
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A drawing with dimensions proportional to an original figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A plane used to locate points with ordered pairs.

extracted_concepts.name: Right Triangle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A triangle with one right angle.
